moneyProfitChannels.title: Profit by channel
moneyProfitChannels.sub: Ad spend on Meta, Google, YouTube and TikTok set against the Sales each brought in, against organic and the other channels — with returns and profit after ads.

kpi.spendNone: No ad spend imported for these days
kpi.spendUnknown: Not shown while a platform's spend has no taka amount

table.title: Channel by channel
table.sub: Contribution = Sales − goods that came back − product cost + delivery charges − courier, fees, packaging, messages and return loss. Profit after ads = contribution − that platform's ad spend. Margin = profit ÷ Sales with a cost.
table.noCost: {amount} with no cost yet (left out of profit)
table.missing: {n} orders miss a cost part (courier, COD fee, payment fee or packaging): the profit is short of it
table.spendUnknown: A day's spend has no taka amount yet (add the USD rate on Money → Costs & fees)
table.empty: No delivered orders and no ad spend in this period.

rules.title: More options: how an order is put in an ad channel
rules.sub: An order the ad platform tagged, or one from one of your ad accounts' campaigns, goes to that platform. Otherwise these UTM words decide: a paid medium plus a platform's source. A paid medium with another source is "Other ads". Words are separated by commas.
rules.paid: UTM mediums that mean a paid visit
rules.stale: Someone else changed these words. Open the page again.
rules.bad: Could not save: check the words (at most 30 each, 40 letters each).
rules.readOnly: Only someone with the costs permission can change these words.
